# DrawSew

> DrawSew (Elite Draw Sew) is a professional embroidery digitizing studio. We convert logos and artwork into clean, machine-ready embroidery files (DST, PES, EXP, EMB, JEF, VP3 and others), delivered in 6-12 hours. 800+ logos digitized. First sample always free.

## Services

- Embroidery digitizing: logo to stitch file conversion for all major machine formats
- 3D puff digitizing for caps and hats
- Patch digitizing (embroidered patches)
- Vector art cleanup and conversion (JPG, PNG, PDF, photos to vector)
- Format conversion between DST, PES, EXP, EMB, JEF, VP3 (always free)

## Pricing

- Simple designs: from $8
- Standard logos: $15
- Complex designs (3D puff, jacket backs): $25+
- First sample: free, no charge and no obligation
- Exact quote given before work starts; free revisions until the design sews cleanly

## Turnaround

- Standard delivery: 6-12 hours
- Rush jobs: priority handling on request

## FAQ

- What is embroidery digitizing? Converting a logo into stitch data (a file like DST or PES) that an embroidery machine can sew.
- Which formats do you deliver? DST, PES, EXP, EMB, JEF, VP3, and others on request. Format conversion is always free.
- How fast is delivery? Standard turnaround is 6-12 hours.
- Is the first sample really free? Yes, completely free with no obligation.
- Do you offer free revisions? Yes, until the design sews cleanly on your machine.
